provenance: Kaggle PaySim1 Synthetic Financial Dataset for Fraud Detection (ealaxi/paysim1, Lopez-Rojas et al.)
license: CC BY 4.0 International (Open Access Research Dataset)
domain: Mobile Money Network (Agent-based mobile financial service simulation)
domain_comparison: PaySim models mobile money agent transactions (CASH-IN, CASH-OUT, DEBIT, PAYMENT, TRANSFER). Key domain differences from Indian banking: (1) PaySim operates in an abstracted mobile-money currency without IFSC/branch routing or KYC account tiers; (2) Fraud manifests as account-takeover transfers and cashouts; (3) Transaction graphs are predominantly star-shaped around agents rather than dense circular mule rings found in corporate/UPI laundering.
synthetic_disclaimer: PaySim is a multi-agent simulation based on aggregated mobile money logs. Results demonstrate algorithmic capability but do not establish real-world judicial accuracy in bank environments.
